observations: Photo 0 shows a beige 2-seater couch with rounded armrests and a low backrest, placed against a yellow wall on a tiled floor.
Photo 1 is a closer view of the same couch, showing the front and side, with visible creases and minor stains on the fabric.
The couch appears to be made of fabric, possibly microfiber or vinyl, with no visible brand or model markings.
The lighting is warm and indoor, with no visible signs of recent use or damage.
The seller claims it is 'very neat' and 'bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm'.

claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Photos show minor creases and stains, contradicting 'very neat' and 'bought new last year'.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Hidden stains, odors, or damage not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up shot of the fabric under direct light, especially in creases and seams, and a video of the couch being touched or moved.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially stained or damaged, reducing value.

risks.risk: Fabric is not as described (e.g., microfiber vs. vinyl, or low quality)
risks.proof: Close-up of the fabric texture and stitching quality, and a shot of the underside or back of the couch.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lower quality material, reducing value.

risks.risk: Couch is not in original condition (e.g., broken springs, loose foam, or missing parts)
risks.proof: Video of the couch being pressed, moved, or shaken to test for stability and foam integrity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially unstable or low-quality foam, reducing value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the fabric texture and stitching quality.
Video of the couch being pressed, moved, or shaken to test for stability and foam integrity.
Close-up shot of the fabric under direct light, especially in creases and seams.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
